units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 5:7">Kel. V, 7</cite> <he>גורר את הט׳</he> scrapes the plastering off.
<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 4:18">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. IV, 18</cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 6:7">Ber. VI, 7</cite> <he>כל שהוא עיקר ועמו ט׳</he> whatever food is the chief dish and something is offered to be eaten with it.—Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 27; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 45:6">Ex. R. s. 45</cite>, end, v. <cite ref="A03444"><he>אָתַר</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:5:16">Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ט׳ לט׳</he> (not <he>בט׳</he>) distant relations, grand-children.—Pl. <he>טְפֵילוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:16">Y. Meg. I, 71ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>טְפֵילוֹתֵיהֶם</he> their affixes (prefixes and suffixes).
